sessions.title: Approach calibration
sessions.purpose: Demonstrate carry-window evidence linked to a Harada commitment.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.instructions: Make easy wedge swings, then a few relaxed 9i shots. Set one target before the measured block.

blocks.title: Calibration
blocks.instructions: Hit eight 5i shots to the same target. Record carry for each shot and mark clean or mishit contact. Step away between shots; do not chase a longer shot.

blocks.title: Transfer
blocks.instructions: Alternate 9i and 5i for eight shots. Use the full pre-shot routine and record the intended target and miss direction.

blocks.title: Close
blocks.instructions: Review the carry window and write one observation for the diary. Stop at the planned time.

success_criteria: Record all eight carries and contact notes.
Complete the full routine on every measured shot.
sessions.stop_rule: Stop at 40 minutes. If time is short, reduce repetitions while keeping the routine; do not rush to finish.

sessions.title: Contact and transfer
sessions.purpose: Demonstrate transfer from a familiar drill into normal shots.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.instructions: Use easy wedge swings to find balance and contact.

blocks.title: One drill
blocks.instructions: Use the familiar 9-to-3 drill with 9i for 12 balls at comfortable effort. Keep one cue for the block.

blocks.title: Transfer
blocks.instructions: Hit 15 normal 9i shots to one target. Count solid strikes and note short, long, left or right misses. Reset the routine between shots.

blocks.title: Close
blocks.instructions: Write the solid-contact count and one observation. Finish at the time limit, regardless of the last shot.

success_criteria: Record solid contact out of 15 transfer shots.
sessions.stop_rule: Stop at 40 minutes. If time is short, reduce repetitions while keeping the routine; do not rush to finish.

sessions.title: Short-game calibration
sessions.purpose: Demonstrate a simple landing-window and recovery session.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.instructions: Hit five easy chips to a broad landing area.

blocks.title: Landing window
blocks.instructions: Play 10 pitches from one comfortable distance. Pick a landing area before each ball. Count landings in that area; observe rollout.

blocks.title: Up-and-down practice
blocks.instructions: Play six separate chip-and-putt attempts with a full routine. Record attempts completed and outcomes without restarting.

blocks.title: Close
blocks.instructions: Record the landing-window count and one takeaway. Leave any unfinished reps for another session.

success_criteria: Record landing-window hits out of 10 and six recovery attempts.
sessions.stop_rule: Stop at 40 minutes. If time is short, reduce repetitions while keeping the routine; do not rush to finish.

sessions.title: Putting and pressure

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.instructions: Roll six putts from a comfortable short distance to settle pace and start line.

blocks.title: Short putting
blocks.instructions: Hit 20 putts from 4 feet, in groups of five. Use the full routine. Count makes; do not restart a group after a miss.

blocks.title: Lag putting
blocks.instructions: Hit 15 putts from 24 feet. Count finishes within 3 feet. Reset between balls and note long or short bias.

blocks.title: Close
blocks.instructions: Play five putts from 5 feet as single attempts, then stop. Record makes, lag proximity and one observation.

success_criteria: Record short-putt makes out of 20 and lag successes out of 15.
sessions.process_commitment: Complete the routine, accept the result.
sessions.stop_rule: Stop at 40 minutes. If time is short, reduce repetitions while keeping the routine; do not rush to finish.
